summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery requires single-writer lock and validates LKG pointer, generation identity, artifact hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; older LKG allowed only if ancestor and all indexed inputs byte-match main; restores four formal layers plus pointers, then revalidates publication, query gate, and Locator smoke; stale LKG cannot override newer main; failed checks or activation roll back and verify prior bytes, with current pointer last; publication control scripts must match pinned main; stale-lock recovery rules include PID/process identity, 60-second malformed-lock grace, live or indeterminate owner conflicts; pruning is separate via prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune and never automatic; protects current, LKG, and five newest valid successful main-added generations; success uses complete manifest/artifact/layer/policy/source/query checks, never mtime; invalid or unrecognized generations are retained; pruning records intent, per-generation authorization, isolation, and outcome evidence; failure evidence under logs/knowledge-context/ is append-only and out of pruning scope; extends ADR-0048 and complements ADR-0044 without superseding either; repository authority and consumer freeze points unchanged
